connected Ctrl-wheel events consume once with nonpassive capture, while regular wheel stays untouched

scope: Pure numerical and native ArcRotateCamera movement/view checks, plus connected LinkeDOM wheel events and explicit capture/nonpassive registration auditing. LinkeDOM does not implement browser capture-order dispatch; native capture-before-Babylon A/B is independently verified. No browser automation/GPU/device performance claim.
